description: Assembly source code implementing cryptographic hash functions and operations for BoringSSL's FIPS module, including functions for Galois field multiplication and hashing optimized for Apple ARM64 architecture.

methods.name: _gcm_init_v8
methods.description: Initializes the hash subkey table for Galois field multiplication.

methods.name: _gcm_gmult_v8
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication of a 128-bit input with the hash subkey.

methods.name: _gcm_ghash_v8
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using precomputed hash subkeys.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_v8_4x
methods.description: Optimized GHASH processing for four blocks in parallel.
